$comment: The software both Bunyi apps are built on, and the models they download.
Shared because the credits should not disagree between platforms, and
because the two apps genuinely share most of what they depend on for the
part that matters — the models. They share no code (see /AGENTS.md); this
is data, and each app reads it in its own way.
Every licence here was read from that project's own licence file, its
package metadata, its model card, or its README. Never from memory: a
credits list that guesses is a licence claim the project cannot support.
Check the README before concluding a project has no licence. One entry
here states MIT only there, with no LICENSE file — so the GitHub API
reports none and file listings show none. Absence of a LICENSE file is
not absence of a licence. Where a project genuinely states none, this
says so, because that is information rather than an omission to tidy
'apps' says which app ships or downloads the entry. 'kind' separates the
libraries an app is built from ('library') from the models it fetches
